review_evidence: README identifies this as a Lean library demonstrating generation and verification of Unicode skip-list tables for the Unicode numeric property.

Direct inspection of UnicodeSkipListTableExample/Unicode.lean found typed Unicode general-category and bidi-class enumerations plus UnicodeDataGC and summary structures; Parse.lean maps UnicodeData.txt into that model.
Generation.lean and Verification.lean were inspected and retained because they encode the source-local construction and reference-comparison workflow for the generated table.
Direct inspection of lakefile.lean found only Lake package/dependency, library, and executable-target configuration.

rules.content_invariant: The excluded file owns only package/dependency and target declarations; all Unicode data types, parsing logic, table-generation use, and reference verification remain searchable.
evidence: lakefile.lean imports Lake, requires UnicodeSkipListTable, and declares the library plus generate_tables/verify_tables executable targets; it contains no Unicode definition or proof.
rules.rationale: Exclude the exact Lake build configuration while retaining the Unicode model, parser, generation, and verification sources.

summary: Retain the Unicode skip-list example's formal Unicode model and construction/verification code; exclude only its Lake build configuration.
